description: Implementation of the abstract rx::TextureImpl class, including method definitions related to texture copying, memory management, and texture data retrieval within the ANGLE graphics project.

classes.name: TextureImpl
classes.description: Abstract class implementing texture operations in ANGLE's renderer.

methods.name: copyTexture
methods.description: Copies texture data from source to destination.

methods.name: copySubTexture
methods.description: Copies a sub-region of a texture.

methods.name: copy3DSubTexture
methods.description: Copies a sub-region of a 3D texture.

methods.name: setImageExternal
methods.description: Sets external image data for a texture.

methods.name: getMemorySize
methods.description: Returns the memory size of the texture.

methods.name: getLevelMemorySize
methods.description: Returns memory size for a specific mipmap level.

methods.name: getColorReadFormat
methods.description: Gets the format used for reading color data.

methods.name: getColorReadType
methods.description: Gets the type used for reading color data.
